notes: [P2] render layering: drawLantern paints its light pool (radius TILE*3, translucent, centre alpha 0.42) and then its body in one call, and draw calls it once per tower in order. A later lantern's pool therefore lands on top of any earlier lantern's body within three tiles, and on the hover highlight, so lanterns placed close together tint each other. The fix is to draw every pool in one pass before any lantern body, either by splitting the pool into its own exported helper or by having draw loop over the towers twice.

[P2] naming: render.js still exports PALETTE as an alias of THEME only so that older health-bar tests keep reading colours by that name. That leaves two names for one token set. Moving those tests to THEME and dropping the alias would make theme.js the only source, as the brief describes.
